candidates.snippet: An investigation by The Associated Press and FRONTLINE (PBS) finds the U.S. lacks an official system to help scam victims recover losses and lags other countries. https://t.co/PLqse7nzAs

The amount of money Americans lost in scams hit a record high of almost $16 billion in 2025. And while federal efforts seek to address the problem, thousands of Americans scammed every day never get their money back. https://t.co/zJBVRg0ufr
